name: Kangoku ~Kairaku Kousei Project~
original_name: 甘獄 ～快楽更生プロジェクト～
source:

he goes to see the next four women he's going to rehabilitate ... "Ah! No, stop! It's going in, it's going in! This is the daily life of Teruaki Kashida, a perverted prison guard , who rapes the busty female prisoners under the guise of rehabilitation.
